newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu expected in France Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu expected in France Thursday.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko will return on Thursday to his French Riviera villa where he convalesced from cancer treatment late last year, a French official said on Wednesday.
Mobutu was expected to arrive at midday at Nice airport on a private flight, the office of the prefect (government representative) in the French Riviera capital said.
The duration and reasons for his visit were not known. The official said he had been granted an open-ended French visa.
Mobutu returned home to Kinshasa last December 17 vowing to do all in his power to drive out rebels who have seized a large slice of eastern Zaire.
After cancer surgery in Switzerland, he had been resting at his palatial mansion in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, near Nice.
The rebels led by longtime Mobutu opponent Laurent Kabila have vowed to overthrow Mobutu, who has ruled the mineral-rich country for 31 years.
Last month Kabila said the rebels had beaten back several counter-attacks by government troops.
